#rom debug
#save after-first-dungeon
# DX Gummis at a Rescue Camp come from Kangaskhan storage: Give Gummi lists the stored Gummis (with counts);
# feeding one takes it from storage and raises a stat by 1 (a DX Gummi also grants a Rare Quality). The
# toolbox is left alone. Generated by tools/dxtest/gen_gummi_tests.py.
mash START sMainMenu 4 != 0 3000
wait 60
press UP
press A
wait 30
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press A
wait 30
expect *sMainMenu+4 4 == 53
wait 10
write *gTeamInventoryRef+0 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+4 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+8 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+12 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+16 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+20 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+24 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+28 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+32 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+36 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+40 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+44 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+48 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+52 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+56 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+60 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+64 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+68 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+72 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+76 1 0
write *gTeamInventoryRef+0 1 1
write *gTeamInventoryRef+2 1 82
write *gTeamInventoryRef+252 2 2
write *gTeamInventoryRef+558 2 1
write *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3733 1 0
read a0 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3720 1
read a_s1 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3721 1
calc a1 a0 + a_s1
read a_s2 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3722 1
calc a2 a1 + a_s2
read a_s3 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3723 1
calc a3 a2 + a_s3
press R
wait 40
shot rainbow_1_list
press A
wait 90
shot rainbow_2_ate
press A
wait 60
shot rainbow_3_back
# one Rainbow Gummi left in storage, one stat +1, the Apple still in the toolbox
expect *gTeamInventoryRef+252 2 == 1
expect *gTeamInventoryRef+558 2 == 1
expect *gTeamInventoryRef+2 1 == 82
expect *gTeamInventoryRef+4 1 == 0
read b0 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3720 1
read b_s1 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3721 1
calc b1 b0 + b_s1
read b_s2 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3722 1
calc b2 b1 + b_s2
read b_s3 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3723 1
calc b3 b2 + b_s3
calc a4 a3 + 1
cmpreads b3 == a4
press R
wait 40
shot dx_1_list
press DOWN
wait 10
press A
wait 90
shot dx_2_ate
press A
wait 120
shot dx_2_ate_2
press A
wait 60
shot dx_3_back
# the DX Gummi is gone from storage, another stat +1, and a Rare Quality
expect *gTeamInventoryRef+558 2 == 0
expect *gTeamInventoryRef+252 2 == 1
expect *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3733 1 != 0
read quality *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3733 1
read c0 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3720 1
read c_s1 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3721 1
calc c1 c0 + c_s1
read c_s2 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3722 1
calc c2 c1 + c_s2
read c_s3 *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3723 1
calc c3 c2 + c_s3
calc b4 b3 + 1
cmpreads c3 == b4
